content_sections.heading: Akashvani Srinagar Part-Time Correspondent (PTC) Recruitment 2026 - Overview
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the number of vacancies or the application fee.

rows.prasar_bharati_akashvani_srinagar_akashv: Monthly remuneration as per NSD Circular No. RNU/PTC Guidelines/Modification/2022/1152 dated 28 August 2024
PG Diploma/Degree in Journalism/Mass Media or graduation with a minimum of two years of journalistic experience; knowledge of computers and word processing; possession of news-gathering devices
24 to 50 years (as on the last date of the advertisement)
The Head of Office Akashvani, Srinagar, P.O. General Post Office Srinagar-190001

content_sections.heading: Akashvani Srinagar Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. AIR/SGR/DDG/2026 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download Akashvani Srinagar notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Other conditions: Must reside at the respective district headquarters or within 10 km of the district headquarters/municipal limit in the district for which engaged Knowledge of computers and word processing Possession of news-gathering devices Desirable: Experience in covering news for electronic media

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for Akashvani Srinagar Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Persons already in Central/State Government or Union Territory Administration service Persons employed by a Public Sector Undertaking (PSU) Members of any political party

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Monthly remuneration will be calculated as per NSD Circular No. RNU/PTC Guidelines/Modification/2022/1152, dated 28 August 2024, subject to satisfactory performance certified by the RNU Head, Akashvani, Srinagar. Engaged on a contractual retainership basis Performance monitored for three months initially, with the contract renewed monthly during this period If performance is satisfactory, a yearly contract may be offered until the candidate reaches 60 years of age Satisfactory performance must be certified by the RNU Head

content_sections.heading: How Will Akashvani Srinagar Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Interview Interview assesses qualifications and professional experience, knowledge of the district and state, and current affairs Also assesses awareness of Central Government welfare schemes and familiarity with radio news Also assesses journalistic aptitude, writing skills and familiarity with communication technologies

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Self-attested age-proof document (Aadhaar, SSLC certificate, PAN card or driving licence/photo ID) Self-attested address-proof document (residential proof) Self-attested copies of qualification certificates, including degree and PG diploma Experience certificates One recent photograph Proof of computer knowledge and audio/visual coverage experience, if available

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Akashvani Srinagar Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Obtain the application proforma attached to the notice or from https://newsonair.gov.in/vacancies/ or https://prasarbharati.gov.in/en/pbvacancies/. Fill the application in the prescribed format and affix a passport size photograph. Attach self-attested copies of the required documents and one recent photograph. Send by registered post to The Head of Office Akashvani, Srinagar, P.O. General Post Office Srinagar-190001. Application must reach by 30 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Engagement is as per the Revised Scheme for Engagement of PTCs available on www.newsonair.gov.in under the PTC Guidelines section Candidature and engagement can be cancelled without notice if any information is found wrong Enquiries: Telephone 0194-2452019, Mobile 7006958620, Monday to Friday, 10:00 AM to 5:00 PM Enquiry email: [email protected]

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Akashvani Srinagar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How do I apply for Akashvani Srinagar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Application proforma attached to the notice (page 3); also at https://newsonair.gov.in/vacancies/ and https://prasarbharati.gov.in/en/pbvacancies/) and send it to The Head of Office Akashvani, Srinagar, P.O. General Post Office Srinagar-190001, by registered post, to reach by 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for Akashvani Srinagar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit is 24 to 50 years (as on the last date of the advertisement).

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Monthly remuneration as per NSD Circular No. RNU/PTC Guidelines/Modification/2022/1152 dated 28 August 2024.

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: PG Diploma/Degree in Journalism/Mass Media or graduation with a minimum of two years of journalistic experience; knowledge of computers and word processing; possession of news-gathering devices.

faq.question: Q6. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Must reside at the respective district headquarters or within 10 km of the district headquarters/municipal limit in the district for which engaged. Knowledge of computers and word processing. Possession of news-gathering devices.

faq.question: Q7. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Persons already in Central/State Government or Union Territory Administration service. Persons employed by a Public Sector Undertaking (PSU). Members of any political party.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Interview. Interview assesses qualifications and professional experience, knowledge of the district and state, and current affairs. Also assesses awareness of Central Government welfare schemes and familiarity with radio news. Also assesses journalistic aptitude, writing skills and familiarity with communication technologies.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Engaged on a contractual retainership basis. Performance monitored for three months initially, with the contract renewed monthly during this period. If performance is satisfactory, a yearly contract may be offered until the candidate reaches 60 years of age.

faq.question: Q10. Which places are covered by Akashvani Srinagar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Srinagar district, Kupwara district.
